events.description: Rachel Green asks whether Ross Geller is sure and whether Ross Geller is ok.

Phoebe Buffay says Rachel Green's clothes all match.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is going to coordinate Phoebe Buffay's clothes so they all match like Rachel Green's.
Phoebe Buffay asks how Monica Geller and Joey Tribbiani's plan went.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller and Joey Tribbiani ripped a couple apart and kept the pieces for Monica Geller Geller and Joey Tribbiani.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is fine.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is sorry.
Rachel Green asks where Chandler Bing is.

Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is free.
